column11: JUDGEMENT from a cited analogue. AMALTHEA, the Phase IIa (NCT06450197, 120 patients, CDAI remission), reached its actual primary completion on 2026-04-30 and AstraZeneca expects data in H2 2026 (appendix of 27 July 2026). No Phase III is registered. The analogue is tulisokibart, the TL1A antibody whose Crohn's Phase 3 followed a Crohn's Phase 2a: APOLLO-CD (NCT05013905) completed 2022-09-23, its Crohn's Phase 3 (NCT06430801) started 2024-06-05 and completes 2028-10-30, so a first full year in 2030, about 7.3 years after the Phase 2a. The same path from 2026-04-30 gives a Phase 3 completing in 2032 and a first full year in 2034
column12: duvakitug is the faster path: RELIEVE UCCD (NCT05499130, Phase 2b) completed 2024-11-12 and STARSCAPE-1 (NCT07184931) completes 2029-05-14, 4.5 years later, which would give 2032. A Phase 2a without a dose-ranging Phase 2b leans to the slower path
